This ensures that the same unregistration logic is applied consistently whether the failure occurs during `rtnl_configure_link` or `dev_change_net_namespace`.
- The patch addresses a specific bug related to the handling of network device unregistration when a namespace change fails, ensuring that the device is properly cleaned up in both failure scenarios. This change enhances code maintainability and reduces redundancy.
